moves.label: Combo decay cost
moves.help: Physics decay added once per attack use, including multi-hit attacks. Separate from damage scaling.

moves.label: Extra starter decay
moves.help: Additional physics decay when this attack starts a combo. Applies to its launch and later attacks.

moves.label: Ground hit speed
moves.help: Initial horizontal speed on a grounded hit, before combo decay. Friction slows it each action frame.

moves.label: Air hit speed
moves.help: Initial horizontal speed on an airborne hit, before decay and inherited momentum. Continues through the launch.

rules.label: Combo decay physics
rules.help: 1 uses decay, velocity knockback and Strive-style gatlings. 0 replays the legacy distance-budget and unified gatling rules.

rules.label: Pushback increase / decay point %
rules.help: Both grounded and airborne hit speed grow with accumulated decay.

rules.label: Launch reduction / decay point %
rules.help: Reduces upward launches and ground-bounce speed; downward spikes retain their authored speed.

rules.label: Minimum upward launch %
rules.help: Floor for upward launch and bounce strength. No universal bounce-count limit.

rules.label: Standing speed retained / frame %
rules.help: Higher values let hit pushback slide farther. Hitstop freezes this clock.

rules.label: Crouching speed retained / frame %
rules.help: Crouching when a grounded combo starts gives stronger friction.

rules.label: Air speed retained / frame %
rules.help: Horizontal drift retained each airborne reaction frame.

rules.label: Incoming air velocity carried %
rules.help: Adds part of the target's incoming horizontal and vertical velocity to the next air hit.

rules.label: Extra gravity after decay
rules.help: Decay points allowed before general gravity scaling. Repeated-attack gravity applies independently from its configured use count.

rules.label: Gravity increase / excess decay %
rules.help: Additional gravity per decay point beyond the threshold, combined with repeated-attack gravity under the gravity cap.
